ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Harmonious? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Harmonious.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Harmonious.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Harmonious.

11. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe in? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe in.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe in.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe in.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Communicating messages and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Engaging parents or and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Soil environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Improving soil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 100 °C

2. C — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.

4. C — Glucose and oxygen

5. D — Ice melting to water

6. A — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. A — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

8. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Harmonious.

11. C — Producers

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe in.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Communicating messages; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Engaging parents or; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Caring for Soil environment; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Improving soil; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
